title: The Slow Colony
author: Freya Halloran
blurb: Jude Ishikawa, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
